description: List current investment positions (ticker, name, quantity, price, market value, cost basis, gain/loss) across connected investment accounts, largest value first, plus portfolio totals. Cost basis and gain/loss are null when the institution doesn't report cost basis. Paginated with limit/offset (default 50, max 200). The response includes a `warnings` array of notices about banks that could not contribute (for example, a bank that needs reconnecting), each with a message and, when relevant, a reconnect_url.

account_id.description: Limit results to one investment account. Use an account id returned by list_accounts.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (1 to 200). Defaults to 50.

offset.description: Number of results to skip, for paging. Defaults to 0. Use with has_more.

name: list_holdings
title: List Investment Holdings
